note: Requests that return an error ON PURPOSE. The render audit lists these as 'expected' so they stay visible, and does not fail the run for them. Every entry needs a reason, and a reason that is really 'we have not fixed it yet' does not belong here — put it on the list of things to fix instead. An allowlist is how a real regression gets hidden, so this file should stay short.

expected.reason: status.html pings the subscription Worker's root to see if it is alive. The Worker has no route for '/', so it answers 404 — and a 404 IS an answer, which is what the ping is testing. The check treats any response as reachable, so this works exactly as intended and the status row reads Online.
